$comment: Machine-readable summary of the Charness License for people and AI agents deciding whether a licence is needed and what it costs. LICENSE is the binding text; src/__tests__/licensingData.test.ts keeps the two in agreement.

organizationLicence.rule: Find the band of R and the band of H separately and pay the higher price.

aiTraining.fee: the group's band price (organizationLicence), yearly, for every year the group uses, sells or offers a model trained on Charness code or commits, on top of the organization licence; $0 only in the Free band; an individual counts as a group of its own

steps: Check whether the group is free (LICENSE Part 1); if it is, nothing is needed.
Work out the band from the latest month-end R and H, and any discount (LICENSE 3.1, 3.6).
E-mail an order to the contact: legal name and country, covered group, R and H bands, term (1, 2 or 3 years), discounts, invoice e-mail.
Keep the invoice and the receipt: they are the licence.
